headline: Dinamo's scoring run meets a NEC side without Tadić
summary: Dinamo Zagreb arrive after a 5-1 win away at Slaven Belupo on Sunday, and they are unbeaten in the Europa League. On Thursday they host NEC Nijmegen, who have drawn their last 4 and lost the game before. NEC travel without Dušan Tadić, their most-used player, though they made 3.06 expected goals on Sunday and still only drew. Dion Beljo has 12 goals this season for the home side. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Dinamo are 58.4% favourites, and the market rates them 0.88 goals stronger. The fair goal line sits at 3.04.
read: Dinamo Zagreb are clear favourites at home: four wins in five, fourteen goals in that run and an unbeaten Europa League start, against a NEC side that has drawn four in a row and travels without Dušan Tadić. The market also expects goals — a fair total line of 3.04, with Dinamo rated about nine-tenths of a goal the better team.

facts.fact: Dinamo Zagreb are 58.4% to win at home, against NEC's 19.8% — nearly three times the away chance.
facts.meaning: The market makes Dinamo clear favourites: more likely than not to win inside 90 minutes, with the draw at 21.8% the only other serious outcome.

facts.fact: Dinamo won 5-1 away at Slaven Belupo on Sunday, with 3.78 xG to 2.19 against.
facts.meaning: They arrive four days after their biggest scoring day of the run, and the chance creation matched the scoreline.

facts.fact: NEC have drawn their last four matches, and lost the game before that 0-5 at Juventus — DDDDL, no win in five.
facts.meaning: They are hard to beat but cannot turn good spells into wins, which is exactly how the market prices them: an outsider, not a crisis club.

facts.fact: Dušan Tadić is missing for Thursday's match, reported from NEC's press conference in Zagreb.
facts.meaning: He has played 1,082 minutes this season, more than any other NEC player — the man who normally carries their build-up is not on the trip.

facts.fact: Dinamo striker Dion Beljo has scored 12 goals in 13 appearances this season, according to the Standard.
facts.meaning: He is the finisher behind Dinamo's scoring run and the obvious problem for a NEC back line missing Nuytinck and Sandler.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line is -0.88, with a full -1 line on offer and Dinamo priced at 46.5% to cover it.
facts.meaning: Dinamo are rated about nine-tenths of a goal better than NEC — a one-goal win would be roughly a coin-flip against the -1 line.

facts.fact: Dinamo have averaged 2.29 xG across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are not winning on luck: they create more than two goals' worth of chances per game, which is why the home favouritism is so firm.

facts.fact: NEC created 3.06 xG at home to Fortuna Sittard on Sunday and still only drew.
facts.meaning: The chances are there — the wins are not, so NEC arrive as an outsider with a real attacking case rather than a team being outplayed every week.

sources.fact: Dinamo Zagreb are unbeaten so far in the Europa League and want to stay that way against NEC on Thursday.
Dinamo Zagreb have had some difficulties at the start of the season, though they remain a dangerous opponent, according to Vi.
